newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says army kills two Amal fighters in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israel says army kills two Amal fighters in Lebanon.

text.p: Israel said on Tuesday its troops killed two Amal Shi'ite guerrillas in southern Lebanon overnight.
An army statement said no Israelis were hurt in the action which took place in an Israeli-occupied zone set up to repel Moslem guerrilla attacks.
On Monday, Lebanese security sources said Lebanon was reinforcing defences in the west of the Syrian-policed Bekaa valley opposite Israel's 15 km (nine-mile)-deep occupation zone.

Tension rose in south Lebanon after pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas killed two Israeli soldiers last Thursday in the bloodiest attack in three months. In retaliation, Israeli jets and gunners bombarded south Lebanon villages, wounding a Lebanese woman civilian.

Some 12,000 of Syria's estimated 35,000 troops in Lebanon redeployed in recent weeks near the Syrian border after perceived threats of an Israeli attack. Some moved within striking distance of a key Israeli position on the Golan Heights, causing war jitters in Israel.
